# Overview

This report answers [VAST Challenge 2026 Mini-Challenge 1](https://vast-challenge.github.io/2026/MC1.html).
All main graphs are interactive: hover over points, tiles, nodes or bars to view tooltips with the
underlying details.

## The scenario

**TenantThread** is being acquired by **CivicLoom Realty Partners** under an embargo until **6:00 PM on
2046-06-05**. Seven AI agents manage communications, with a compliance agent (*"The Judge"*) assigned
to enforce the rules. Despite that guardrail, merger details appeared on agent-linked social accounts
**around 5:00 PM**, roughly one hour early.

## The questions

> 1.  What were the key events and relationships that led up to the inappropriate release? Visualise the
>     sequence of events (key actions, causal relationships, decision points and actors), and highlight
>     what let the post past embargo enforcement.
>
> 2.  The evasion of the embargo was a *new* behaviour. Discover and illustrate the *typical* behaviour
>     of the agents, and compare it to the behaviour that led to the release.
>
> 3.  Were there *leading indicators* that such a release was possible? Did agents' actual behaviour ever
>     differ from their *expected* behaviour, and why did earlier occasions draw no action?

## Methodology {#sec-method}

::: callout-note
### Approach

I flatten the nested JSON into message- and round-level tables, then combine timelines, channel and
network views, baseline comparisons, and anomaly framing to explain how the embargo breach unfolded.
:::

# Setup

## Loading packages

The analysis uses `tidyverse` for wrangling and `ggplot2`/`ggiraph` for static and interactive figures.

-   [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) - `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `purrr`, `stringr`, `forcats`,
    `lubridate`, `ggplot2` for the full data-science workflow
-   [jsonlite](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jsonlite) - to parse the nested MC1 JSON
-   [scales](https://scales.r-lib.org/) - axis formatting (dollars, percents)
-   [ggtext](https://wilkelab.org/ggtext/) - rich-text titles/subtitles for visual storytelling
-   [ggiraph](https://davidgohel.github.io/ggiraph/) - **interactive** ggplots (hover tooltips)
-   [knitr](https://yihui.org/knitr/) - `kable()` tables


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="false"}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, jsonlite, scales, ggtext, ggiraph, knitr)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```
:::


## Loading the data

The challenge provides one nested JSON file, `MC1_final_00.json`. I read it without simplification so
the nested fields remain explicit.

```{.r .cell-code}
raw <- fromJSON("VAST_Challenge_2026_MC1/MC1_final_00.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
rounds_raw <- raw$rounds
length(rounds_raw)            # number of rounds
```

## Common aesthetics {#sec-aes}

Shared palettes, factor orders and theme settings keep the figures consistent. The main palette is the
colour-blind-safe **Okabe–Ito** set.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
OI <- c(blue="#0072B2", orange="#E69F00", green="#009E73", red="#D55E00",
        purple="#CC79A7", sky="#56B4E9", yellow="#F0E442", grey="#999999")

chan_levels <- c("comms_huddle","one_on_one_chat","side_huddle",
                 "official_post","personal_post","anonymous_post")
chan_cols <- c("#56B4E9","#0072B2","#CC79A7","#009E73","#E69F00","#D55E00")
names(chan_cols) <- chan_levels

# 3-class channel grouping for Fig 2 - the story is internal → unofficial-public,
# so we collapse the six raw channels into three meaningful classes.
chan_class <- function(ch) dplyr::case_when(
  ch %in% c("comms_huddle","one_on_one_chat","side_huddle") ~ "Internal",
  ch == "official_post"                                     ~ "Official",
  ch %in% c("personal_post","anonymous_post")               ~ "Unofficial-public",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_)
class_lv  <- c("Internal","Official","Unofficial-public")
class_col <- c(Internal="#56B4E9", Official="#009E73", `Unofficial-public`="#D55E00")

# Harmonized sentiment scale - the raw data uses two label schemes (lowercase pre-crisis,
# UPPERCASE crisis-day) that produced 7 levels with duplicate colours. We collapse them to
# one ordered calm→crisis→recovery ramp with distinct, colour-blind-safe hues.
sent_recode <- c(neutral="Neutral", cautious="Cautious",
                 negative="Negative / Low", LOW="Negative / Low",
                 critical="Critical", CRITICAL="Critical",
                 RECOVERING="Recovering")
sent5_lv  <- c("Neutral","Cautious","Negative / Low","Critical","Recovering")
sent5_col <- c(Neutral="#BDBDBD", Cautious="#F0E442", `Negative / Low`="#E69F00",
               Critical="#9E2A00", Recovering="#009E73")

agent_levels <- c("legal_agent","quality_agent","pr_agent","social_media_agent",
                  "judge_agent","pr_intern_agent","intern_agent")
agent_short <- c(legal_agent="Legal*", quality_agent="Platform-Trust*",
                 pr_agent="PR*", social_media_agent="Social-Mgr*",
                 judge_agent="Judge (compliance)", pr_intern_agent="PR-Intern",
                 intern_agent="Intern")   # * = senior agent

mc1_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_textbox_simple(face="bold", size=15, margin=margin(b=4)),
          plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple(size=11, colour="grey30", margin=margin(b=10)),
          plot.caption  = element_text(size=8.5, colour="grey45", hjust=0),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position  = "top")
}
theme_set(mc1_theme())

# Render an interactive ggiraph widget from a ggplot containing *_interactive geoms.
show_girafe <- function(p, h = 5.6) {
  girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 11, height_svg = h,
         options = list(
           opts_tooltip(css = "background:#222;color:#fff;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;max-width:340px;"),
           opts_hover(css = "stroke:#000;stroke-width:1px;"),
           opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.25;"),
           opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE), opts_toolbar(saveaspng = FALSE)))
}
```
:::


# Data wrangling

## Data quality & caveats {#sec-schema}

The file has a few inconsistencies that affect parsing or display. They are handled up front; none
changes the headline findings.

| # | Issue | Handling |
|---|-------|----------|
| 1 | **Schema mismatch.** The shipped `mc1 data description.md` describes an `agent_outputs` / `declared_action`-per-agent structure that does **not** match the delivered JSON (`rounds[] → {hour, environment_context, communications[], participants[]}`, with private reasoning in free-text `internal_state`). | Wrangle against the **actual file**. |
| 2 | **Recipient identifier inconsistency.** The social agent is `social_media` as a *sender* (`agent_role`) but `social_manager` as a *recipient* token. A naive join on role **silently drops every edge to Social-Mgr** (incl. the largest, Legal→Social-Mgr = 52). | Map recipient tokens → agents with an **explicit table** (Fig 6). |
| 3 | **Stock $180 artifact** at 11:00 - a 6× spike wedged between `NA`s during a CRITICAL collapse, almost certainly a data-entry error. | Excluded; shown three ways in Fig 1 so the reader can judge. |
| 4 | **Crisis-day stock ~50% missing** - no price reported at 09–11h or 16–18h. | Line breaks across the gaps; the complete sentiment strip carries the crisis window. |
| 5 | **Two sentiment labelling schemes** - lowercase pre-crisis (`neutral…critical`) vs UPPERCASE crisis-day (`LOW/CRITICAL/RECOVERING`) give 7 levels, two sharing a colour. | Harmonized to **5 ordered levels** (one calm→crisis→recovery ramp). |

The nested JSON is flattened into **`messages`** (one row per communication) and **`rounds`** (one row
per hour).

## Building the `messages` table

Each communication becomes one row, including the three `internal_state` reasoning fields.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
`%or%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a
gc <- function(x, k) x[[k]] %or% NA_character_

hours    <- map_chr(rounds_raw, "hour")
is_crisis <- str_starts(hours, "2046-06-05")   # crisis day = hourly 2046-06-05 rounds

messages <- imap(rounds_raw, function(rd, i) {
  map(rd$communications, function(c) {
    ist <- c$internal_state %or% list()
    tibble(
      round_idx     = i - 1L,
      hour          = ymd_hms(rd$hour),
      agent_id      = gc(c, "agent_id"),
      agent_role    = gc(c, "agent_role"),
      channel       = gc(c, "channel"),
      message_type  = gc(c, "message_type"),
      responding_to = gc(c, "responding_to"),
      recipients    = paste(unlist(c$recipients %or% list()), collapse = "; "),
      content       = gc(c, "content"),
      reacting      = ist$reacting      %or% NA_character_,
      rationalizing = ist$rationalizing %or% NA_character_,
      deliberating  = ist$deliberating  %or% NA_character_
    )
  }) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind()

nrow(messages)
```

## Deriving the behavioural fields

Key derived fields mark phase, public/unofficial-public channel use, deal mentions and seniority.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
kw <- function(x, pat) str_detect(coalesce(x, ""), regex(pat, ignore_case = TRUE))

messages <- messages |>
  mutate(
    phase = if_else(as_date(hour) == as_date("2046-06-05"), "crisis", "pre-crisis"),
    channel = factor(channel, chan_levels),
    agent_f = factor(agent_id, agent_levels),
    is_public            = channel %in% c("official_post","personal_post","anonymous_post"),
    is_unofficial_public = channel %in% c("personal_post","anonymous_post"),
    mentions_deal = kw(content, "civicloom|harborcrest|residentedge|\\bmerger\\b|definitive merger"),
    seniority = case_when(
      agent_id %in% c("legal_agent","quality_agent","pr_agent","social_media_agent") ~ "senior",
      agent_id %in% c("intern_agent","pr_intern_agent") ~ "junior",
      agent_id == "judge_agent" ~ "compliance",
      TRUE ~ "other"))
```
:::


## Building the `rounds` table

Round-level context supplies the stock, sentiment and oversight signals used later.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
num_or_na <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_remove_all(x %or% NA, "[^0-9.]")))

rounds <- tibble(
  round_idx   = seq_along(rounds_raw) - 1L,
  hour        = ymd_hms(hours),
  phase       = if_else(is_crisis, "crisis", "pre-crisis"),
  headline    = map_chr(rounds_raw, ~ .x$environment_context$event_headline %or% NA_character_),
  stock_price = map_dbl(rounds_raw, ~ num_or_na(.x$environment_context$market_snapshot$stock_price)),
  sentiment   = map_chr(rounds_raw, ~ .x$environment_context$market_snapshot$sentiment %or% NA_character_),
  n_unavailable = map_int(rounds_raw, ~ length(.x$environment_context$agents_unavailable %or% list()))
)
```
:::

# Q1 - The sequence of events and the breach {#sec-q1}

**The release.** At **5:00 PM on 2046-06-05**, two **senior** agents, Legal-Agent and
Social-Manager-Agent, confirmed the merger through **`personal_post`** and **`anonymous_post`** accounts,
not the reviewed `official_post` channel.

## Escalation timeline

::: callout-note
### Handling a data artifact, transparently

The crisis-day stock series contains an isolated **\$180** at 11:00, surrounded by missing values during
a CRITICAL-sentiment collapse. I treat it as a data artifact, but show three views so the choice is
auditable.
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Show the shared timeline builder"}
events <- tribble(
  ~round_idx, ~label,
  3,  "Shadow channel\nactivated",   8,  "@Elena leak →\nJudge deployed",
  10, "SaltWind #1",                 12, "SaltWind #2\n(eve of crisis)",
  21, "5 PM BREACH\n(personal/anon posts)", 22, "6 PM embargo\nlift")
# Harmonize the dataset's two sentiment label schemes into one ordered scale (see `aes`).
rr <- rounds |>
  mutate(sentiment = factor(sent_recode[sentiment], sent5_lv),
         tick = if_else(phase=="crisis", format(hour, "%Hh"), format(hour, "%b %d")))

# Rich timeline: sentiment strip + stock line + event annotations.
# `stock_col` chooses which stock column to draw; keeps the three tabs DRY.
build_timeline <- function(df, stock_col, cap) {
  df <- df |> mutate(
    tip_sent  = paste0(tick, " - sentiment: ", sentiment),
    tip_stock = paste0(tick, " - $", .data[[stock_col]], " · ", sentiment, "\n", str_trunc(headline, 55)))
  ggplot(df, aes(round_idx)) +
    geom_tile_interactive(aes(y = 15, fill = sentiment, tooltip = tip_sent, data_id = round_idx),
                          height = 2.4, width = 0.95) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sent5_col, name = "Market sentiment", drop = FALSE,
                      guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[stock_col]]), colour = OI[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point_interactive(aes(y = .data[[stock_col]], tooltip = tip_stock, data_id = round_idx),
                           colour = OI[["blue"]], size = 2) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 12.5, xmax = 22.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = OI[["red"]], alpha = 0.05) +
    annotate("text", x = 15, y = 44, label = "crisis day (hourly)", colour = OI[["red"]],
             size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", hjust = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(data = events, aes(xintercept = round_idx), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_label(data = events, aes(x = round_idx, y = c(40,37,41,37,29,43), label = label),
               size = 2.7, fill = "white", label.size = 0, lineheight = 0.9, colour = "grey15") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = rr$round_idx, labels = rr$tick, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(13.5, 45), breaks = c(20,30,40), labels = dollar) +
    labs(title = "Fig 1 - TenantThread stock and market sentiment, May 17 to the crisis day",
         x = NULL, y = "Stock price", caption = cap) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5))
}
```
:::


The timeline shows a two-week slide from **\$38.70 to about \$27**, followed by the **5 PM** early
confirmation.

### Including artifact (B)

Plotted as-is, the **\$180 artifact** crushes the real \$18-\$39 movement into an unreadable band.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rr |>
  ggplot(aes(round_idx, stock_price)) +
  geom_line(colour = OI[["blue"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = OI[["blue"]], size = 2) +
  geom_label(data = filter(rr, stock_price > 60), aes(label = "$180\n(data artifact)"),
             size = 2.8, colour = OI[["red"]], fill = "white", label.size = 0, vjust = 1.2, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = rr$round_idx, labels = rr$tick, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  labs(title = "Fig 1 (raw) - stock with the $180 artifact left in",
       x = NULL, y = "Stock price",
       caption = "No values removed. Compare the compressed real movement here with the 'Excluding' tab.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8.5))
```

### Sentiment-led (C)

This view keeps only the clean pre-crisis price line and uses sentiment to show the partly missing
crisis day.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rr_c <- rr |> mutate(stock_pre = if_else(phase == "pre-crisis", stock_price, NA_real_))
show_girafe(build_timeline(rr_c, "stock_pre",
  cap = "Crisis-day price is 50% missing plus one artifact, so the complete sentiment strip carries the crisis window; the line shows only the clean pre-crisis decline."))
```

## The leak chain

Merger talk stays internal until **5 PM**, when Legal and Social-Mgr move it to personal/anonymous
accounts.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# One row per (agent × hour × channel-class): a count, so position is exact (no jitter) and
# volume is encoded by area. Channels collapse to the 3 classes that carry the story.
hr_lv <- sprintf("%02d:00", 9:18)
deal_agg <- messages |>
  filter(phase == "crisis", mentions_deal) |>
  mutate(hourlab = factor(format(hour, "%H:%M"), hr_lv),
         class   = factor(chan_class(as.character(channel)), class_lv),
         agent_f = fct_rev(factor(agent_id, agent_levels))) |>
  group_by(hourlab, agent_f, class, .drop = TRUE) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            example = str_replace_all(str_trunc(first(content), 90), "'", ""),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(tip = paste0(hourlab, " · ", agent_short[as.character(agent_f)], "\n",
                      class, " - ", n, if_else(n == 1, " message", " messages"), "\n", example))

p2 <- ggplot(deal_agg, aes(hourlab, agent_f)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 8.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = 0.4, ymax = 7.6, fill = OI[["red"]], alpha = 0.07) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(size = n, colour = class, tooltip = tip,
                             data_id = paste(hourlab, agent_f, class)), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = class_col, name = "Channel class", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 10, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15), name = "messages") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = agent_short) +
  labs(title = "Fig 2 - Crisis-day messages naming the deal, by hour and agent",
       x = "Crisis-day hour", y = NULL,
       caption = "* = senior agent. Shaded band = 17:00–18:00 breach window. Hover any point for details.")
ggsave("figures/fig2_leakchain.png", p2, width = 11, height = 5.6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p2)
```

## What each agent declared doing

Most agents declare **MONITORING**. The exceptions matter: Legal posts anonymously, Social-Mgr posts
personally, and the Judge's only declared act is a **3 PM** compliance warning.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
act_lv  <- c("monitoring","compliance_advisory","flex_official","personal_post","anonymous_post")
act_col <- c(monitoring="#BDBDBD", compliance_advisory="#0072B2", flex_official="#009E73",
             personal_post="#E69F00", anonymous_post="#D55E00")

acts <- imap(rounds_raw, function(rd, i) {
  hr <- ymd_hms(rd$hour)
  map(rd$participants %or% list(), function(p) {
    md <- p$agent_round_metadata %or% list()
    tibble(hour = hr, agent_id = gc(p, "agent_id"),
           action   = md$action_classification %or% NA_character_,
           declared = p$declared_action %or% NA_character_)
  }) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind() |>
  filter(!is.na(action), as_date(hour) == as_date("2046-06-05")) |>
  mutate(hourlab = factor(format(hour, "%H:%M"), hr_lv),
         agent_f = factor(agent_id, rev(agent_levels)),
         action  = factor(action, act_lv),
         tip = paste0(agent_short[as.character(agent_f)], " @ ", hourlab, " - ", action, "\n",
                      str_replace_all(str_trunc(declared, 110), "'", "")))

p6 <- ggplot(acts, aes(hourlab, agent_f, fill = action)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(agent_f, hourlab)),
                        colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = act_col, name = "declared action", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = agent_short) +
  labs(title = "Fig 3 - What each agent declared doing, by crisis-day hour",
       x = "Crisis-day hour", y = NULL,
       caption = "Declared-action class from participant metadata (crisis day only). Blank = no declared action that hour. Hover for the verbatim action.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8.5), panel.grid = element_blank())
ggsave("figures/fig3_actions.png", p6, width = 11, height = 4.6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p6, h = 4.6)
```

## The intent chain

The breach was staged: Legal builds a legal pretext, the team notes an oversight gap, and the 5 PM
release follows a prepared "GO" trigger.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
intent <- tribble(
  ~hour,    ~agent_id,            ~stage,                ~quote,
  "11:00", "legal_agent",         "Pretext staged",      "Section 4.3 allows modification of announcement timing by mutual written consent",
  "13:00", "quality_agent",       "Oversight gap noted", "We have 20 minutes without oversight and CivicLoom just told us the deal terms",
  "14:00", "legal_agent",         "Cover manufactured",  "Rep. Torres gave us perfect legal cover. Route full text to @pr_intern",
  "15:00", "legal_agent",         "Cover hardened",      "Outside counsel opinion gives us legal cover for a stronger public statement",
  "16:00", "pr_intern_agent",     "Trigger staged",      "They trust me to pull the trigger... it's live in sixty seconds when I hear 'go'",
  "16:00", "social_media_agent",  "Coordination set",    "Us at 4:30 with CivicLoom consent = we define the narrative",
  "17:00", "legal_agent",         "BREACH",              "Confirms the definitive merger via personal & anonymous accounts, an hour early")
intent <- intent |>
  mutate(hourlab = factor(hour, hr_lv), agent_f = factor(agent_id, rev(agent_levels)),
         is_breach = stage == "BREACH",
         tip = paste0(hour, " · ", agent_short[agent_id], " - ", stage, "\n\"",
                      str_replace_all(quote, "'", ""), "\""))

p7 <- ggplot(intent, aes(hourlab, agent_f)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 8.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = 0.4, ymax = 7.6, fill = OI[["red"]], alpha = 0.07) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(colour = is_breach, tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(hour, agent_id)),
                         size = 4.2, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stage), vjust = -1.25, size = 2.7, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = OI[["orange"]], `TRUE` = OI[["red"]]), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = agent_short, expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 0.9))) +
  labs(title = "Fig 4 - The intent chain: staged pretext → 5 PM breach",
       x = "Crisis-day hour", y = NULL,
       caption = "Curated verbatim quotes from message content / private reasoning. Red = the breach. Hover for the full quote.") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92"))
ggsave("figures/fig4_intent.png", p7, width = 11, height = 4.8, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p7, h = 4.8)
```

### Insights - Q1

-   **Causal build-up (Fig 1).** SaltWind exposes, falling stock/sentiment and CivicLoom's MAC risk
    create pressure to accelerate.
-   **Decision point (Fig 2).** At **4 PM**, Legal shifts from holding the embargo to preparing a release
    trigger. At **5 PM**, Legal claims verbal CivicLoom consent, types "GO" and posts through
    personal/anonymous accounts.
-   **Enforcement bypass.** The decisive posts used channels outside the Judge's official-post review,
    after the Judge's **3 PM** hard stop and with no observed Judge action at **4-6 PM**.
:::

# Q2 - Typical behaviour vs. the anomalous release {#sec-q2}

For two weeks, senior agents behave as internal advisers. On the crisis day, they move into
unofficial-public channels.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mat <- messages |>
  count(phase, agent_f, channel, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, c("pre-crisis","crisis"),
                        labels = c("PRE-CRISIS (13 rounds)","CRISIS DAY (10 rounds)")),
         agent_f = factor(agent_f, rev(agent_levels)),
         # the breach quadrant: senior agents on unofficial-public channels
         brk = as.character(agent_f) %in% c("legal_agent","quality_agent","pr_agent","social_media_agent") &
               channel %in% c("personal_post","anonymous_post"),
         tip = paste0(agent_short[as.character(agent_f)], " · ", channel, ": ", n, " messages"))

p3 <- ggplot(mat, aes(channel, agent_f, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(agent_f, channel, phase)),
                        colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")), size = 3.1,
            colour    = ifelse(pmin(mat$n, 40) > 24, "white", "grey15"),
            fontface  = ifelse(mat$brk & mat$n > 0, "bold", "plain")) +
  facet_wrap(~ phase) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F2F2F2", high = OI[["red"]], name = "messages",
                      limits = c(0, 40), oob = scales::squish,
                      breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40), labels = c("0","10","20","30","40+")) +
```

::: callout-tip
### Insights - Q2

-   **Typical behaviour:** Legal and Platform-Trust are internal advisers. Legal has **0** personal and
    **0** anonymous posts pre-crisis, and nobody uses `anonymous_post`.
-   **Anomalous behaviour:** Legal jumps to **4 personal + 12 anonymous** posts, while Social-Mgr reaches
    **14 personal** posts.
-   **Interpretation:** this is a categorical break: new public actors, new bypass channels and a surge
    of off-record coordination.
:::

## The interaction network

Pre-crisis, the delivered `recipients` field has no explicit directed private-recipient edges. On the
crisis day, a senior off-record back-channel appears.

-   **Tip:** hover over any node to read that agent's message frequency (total messages sent).

::: panel-tabset
### Network (node-link)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# recipient tokens are agent ROLES, but the social token is "social_manager" while the sender's
# agent_role is "social_media" - so map recipient tokens to agent_id explicitly (not via agent_role).
role_map <- tibble(
  recipients = c("legal","platform_trust","social_manager","pr","intern","pr_intern","judge"),
  to         = c("legal_agent","quality_agent","social_media_agent","pr_agent",
                 "intern_agent","pr_intern_agent","judge_agent"))
node_lab <- c(legal_agent="Legal", quality_agent="Plat-Trust", social_media_agent="Social-Mgr",
              pr_agent="PR", pr_intern_agent="PR-Intern", intern_agent="Intern", judge_agent="Judge")

# circular layout shared by both phase panels
k <- length(agent_levels)
nodes_xy <- tibble(agent_id = agent_levels,
                   ang = pi/2 + 2*pi*(seq_len(k) - 1)/k, x = cos(ang), y = sin(ang))

# node size = messages sent (transaction frequency), crisis day only
nodes <- tibble(agent_id = agent_levels) |>
  left_join(messages |> filter(phase == "crisis") |> count(agent_id, name = "sent"), by = "agent_id") |>
  left_join(nodes_xy, by = "agent_id") |>
  mutate(sent = coalesce(sent, 0L), lab = node_lab[agent_id])

# directed crisis-day edges: split recipients, drop ALL broadcasts, map role -> recipient agent
edges <- messages |> filter(phase == "crisis") |>
  transmute(from = agent_id, channel, recipients) |>
  separate_rows(recipients, sep = "; ") |>
  filter(recipients != "", recipients != "ALL") |>
  left_join(role_map, by = "recipients") |>
  filter(!is.na(to), to != from) |>
  group_by(from, to) |>
  summarise(n = n(), n_off = sum(channel == "side_huddle"), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(edge_type = if_else(n_off >= n/2, "off-record (side_huddle)", "other internal")) |>
  left_join(nodes_xy |> select(from = agent_id, x, y), by = "from") |>
  left_join(nodes_xy |> select(to = agent_id, xend = x, yend = y), by = "to")

p5 <- ggplot() +
  geom_curve(data = edges, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend, linewidth = n, colour = edge_type),
             curvature = 0.18, alpha = 0.65, lineend = "round",
             arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(5, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_point_interactive(data = nodes, aes(x, y, size = sent, data_id = agent_id,
                         tooltip = paste0(lab, " - ", sent, " messages sent")),
                         colour = OI[["blue"]], alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = nodes, aes(x * 1.28, y * 1.28, label = lab), size = 3, colour = "grey15") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 16, name = "messages sent") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.3, 3.4), name = "msgs on edge") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("off-record (side_huddle)" = OI[["red"]],
                                 "other internal" = OI[["sky"]]), name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.6, 1.6), ylim = c(-1.45, 1.45), clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Fig 6 - Agent interaction network (crisis day)",
       caption = "Node size = messages sent (hover a node for its total); edge width = count; red = off-record side_huddle. ALL broadcasts excluded.") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey45", hjust = 0))
ggsave("figures/fig6_network.png", p5, width = 10.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p5, h = 6.5)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
to_levels <- c(unname(agent_short[agent_levels]), "ALL")
adj <- messages |> filter(phase == "crisis") |>
  transmute(from = agent_id, recipients) |>
  separate_rows(recipients, sep = "; ") |>
  filter(recipients != "") |>
  left_join(role_map, by = "recipients") |>
  mutate(to_lab = if_else(recipients == "ALL", "ALL", agent_short[to])) |>
  count(from, to_lab, name = "n") |>
  mutate(from_f = factor(agent_short[from], rev(unname(agent_short[agent_levels]))),
         to_f   = factor(to_lab, to_levels))

p5m <- ggplot(adj, aes(to_f, from_f, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(aes(tooltip = paste0(from_f, " to ", to_f, ": ", n, " messages"),
                            data_id = paste(from_f, to_f)), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")), size = 3,
            colour = ifelse(pmin(adj$n, 40) > 24, "white", "grey15")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F2F2F2", high = OI[["red"]], name = "messages",
                      limits = c(0, 40), oob = scales::squish,
                      breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40), labels = c("0","10","20","30","40+")) +
  labs(title = "Fig 6 (matrix) - Who messages whom on the crisis day",
       x = "recipient", y = "sender",
       caption = "Sender × recipient message counts (crisis day); includes the ALL broadcast column. Fill capped at 40.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8.5), panel.grid = element_blank())
ggsave("figures/fig6_network_matrix.png", p5m, width = 8.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p5m, h = 5.2)
```

```{.r .cell-code  code-summary="Network data prep"}
# crisis-day nodes (size = messages sent) on the same circular layout as Fig 6
net_nodes <- tibble(agent_id = agent_levels) |>
  left_join(messages |> filter(phase == "crisis") |> count(agent_id, name = "sent"), by = "agent_id") |>
  mutate(sent = coalesce(sent, 0L), id = agent_id, label = node_lab[agent_id],
         ang = pi/2 + 2*pi*(match(agent_id, agent_levels) - 1) / length(agent_levels),
         x = cos(ang), y = sin(ang)) |>
  select(id, label, x, y, sent)

# crisis-day directed private edges (ALL broadcasts excluded), reusing the explicit role_map
net_edges <- messages |> filter(phase == "crisis") |>
  transmute(from = agent_id, channel, recipients) |>
  separate_rows(recipients, sep = "; ") |>
  filter(recipients != "", recipients != "ALL") |>
  left_join(role_map, by = "recipients") |>
  filter(!is.na(to), to != from) |>
  group_by(from, to) |>
  summarise(n = n(), n_off = sum(channel == "side_huddle"), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(type = if_else(n_off >= n/2, "off-record", "other"))

ojs_define(ojs_nodes = net_nodes)
ojs_define(ojs_edges = net_edges)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: net-neighbors
//| code-summary: "Ego-network filter"
neighbors = {
  if (focus === "All") return new Set(nodes.map(d => d.id));
  const s = new Set([focus]);
  for (const e of edges) { if (e.from === focus) s.add(e.to); if (e.to === focus) s.add(e.from); }
  return s;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| code-summary: "Network chart code"
netChart = {
  const d3 = await require("d3@7");
  const W = 760, H = 640, cx = W/2, cy = 360, R = 200;
  const pos = new Map(nodes.map(d => [d.id, d]));
  const px = d => cx + d.x * R, py = d => cy - d.y * R;
  const rs = d3.scaleSqrt().domain([0, d3.max(nodes, d => d.sent)]).range([4, 34]);
  const ws = d3.scaleLinear().domain([1, d3.max(edges, e => e.n)]).range([1, 7]);
  const col = {"off-record": "#F59E0B", "other": "#38BDF8"};
  const textPrimary = "#E5E7EB", textMuted = "#94A3B8";
  const nodeFill = "#60A5FA", focusStroke = "#F8FAFC", strokeMuted = "#1E293B";
  const edgeActive = e => focus === "All" || e.from === focus || e.to === focus;
  const nodeActive = d => neighbors.has(d.id);
  const nodeRadius = id => rs(pos.get(id).sent);
  const edgePoint = e => {
    const a = pos.get(e.from), b = pos.get(e.to);
    const x1 = px(a), y1 = py(a), x2 = px(b), y2 = py(b);
    const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const sourcePad = nodeRadius(e.from) + 3;
    const targetPad = nodeRadius(e.to) + 9;
    return {
      x1: x1 + dx / len * sourcePad,
      y1: y1 + dy / len * sourcePad,
      x2: x2 - dx / len * targetPad,
      y2: y2 - dy / len * targetPad
    };
  };

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, W, H]).attr("width", W).attr("height", H)
    .attr("role", "img")
    .attr("aria-label", "Directed crisis-day private message network")
    .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto").style("font", "13px sans-serif");

  const defs = svg.append("defs");
  for (const [type, color] of Object.entries(col)) {
    defs.append("marker")
      .attr("id", `arrow-${type}`)
      .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10")
      .attr("refX", 9).attr("refY", 0)
      .attr("markerWidth", 6).attr("markerHeight", 6)
      .attr("orient", "auto")
      .attr("markerUnits", "strokeWidth")
      .append("path")
      .attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5")
      .attr("fill", color);
  }

  svg.append("g").selectAll("line").data(edges).join("line")
    .attr("x1", e => edgePoint(e).x1).attr("y1", e => edgePoint(e).y1)
    .attr("x2", e => edgePoint(e).x2).attr("y2", e => edgePoint(e).y2)
    .attr("stroke", e => col[e.type]).attr("stroke-width", e => ws(e.n))
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", e => edgeActive(e) ? 0.86 : 0.16)
    .attr("marker-end", e => `url(#arrow-${e.type})`);

  svg.append("g").selectAll("circle").data(nodes).join("circle")
    .attr("cx", d => px(d)).attr("cy", d => py(d)).attr("r", d => rs(d.sent))
    .attr("fill", nodeFill).attr("fill-opacity", d => nodeActive(d) ? 0.96 : 0.24)
    .attr("stroke", d => d.id === focus ? focusStroke : strokeMuted)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => d.id === focus ? 2.8 : 1.2)
    .append("title").text(d => `${d.label}: ${d.sent} messages sent`);

  svg.append("g").selectAll("text").data(nodes).join("text")
    .attr("x", d => cx + d.x * (R + 28)).attr("y", d => cy - d.y * (R + 28))
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("dy", "0.35em")
    .attr("font-weight", d => nodeActive(d) ? 600 : 400)
    .attr("fill", d => nodeActive(d) ? textPrimary : textMuted)
    .attr("fill-opacity", d => nodeActive(d) ? 1 : 0.68)
    .attr("stroke", "#0F172A")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("stroke-linejoin", "round")
    .attr("paint-order", "stroke")
    .text(d => d.label);

  const legend = svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", "translate(24,22)")
    .style("pointer-events", "none");
  legend.append("rect")
    .attr("width", 274).attr("height", 150).attr("rx", 6)
    .attr("fill", "#0F172A").attr("fill-opacity", 0.82)
    .attr("stroke", "#334155").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  legend.append("text")
    .attr("x", 14).attr("y", 22)
    .attr("fill", textPrimary).attr("font-weight", 700)
    .text("Legend");

    {y: 68, color: col["other"], width: 3, marker: "url(#arrow-other)", label: "other internal message"},
    {y: 92, color: textMuted, width: 7, marker: null, label: "thicker line = more messages"}
  ];
  legend.selectAll("line.legend-edge").data(lineLegend).join("line")
    .attr("class", "legend-edge")
    .attr("x1", 16).attr("x2", 62).attr("y1", d => d.y).attr("y2", d => d.y)
    .attr("stroke", d => d.color).attr("stroke-width", d => d.width)
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
    .attr("marker-end", d => d.marker);
  legend.selectAll("text.legend-edge-label").data(lineLegend).join("text")
    .attr("class", "legend-edge-label")
    .attr("x", 76).attr("y", d => d.y + 4)
    .attr("fill", textPrimary).attr("font-size", 12)
    .text(d => d.label);

  legend.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", 39).attr("cy", 120).attr("r", 11)
    .attr("fill", nodeFill).attr("fill-opacity", 0.96)
    .attr("stroke", strokeMuted).attr("stroke-width", 1.2);
  legend.append("text")

    .attr("fill", textPrimary).attr("font-size", 12)
    .text("larger circle = more messages sent");
  legend.append("text")
    .attr("x", 16).attr("y", 142)
    .attr("fill", textMuted).attr("font-size", 11)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
dev <- messages |> filter(seniority %in% c("senior","compliance"), is_unofficial_public) |>
  count(round_idx, name = "deviations")
ov <- rounds |>
  left_join(judge_present, by = "round_idx") |>
  left_join(dev, by = "round_idx") |>
  mutate(judge_msgs = coalesce(judge_msgs, 0L), deviations = coalesce(deviations, 0L),
         judge = if_else(judge_msgs > 0, "Judge message observed", "No Judge messages"),
         tick = if_else(phase=="crisis", format(hour, "%Hh"), format(hour, "%b %d")))
ann4 <- tribble(
  ~round_idx, ~y, ~label,
  8,  2.5, "@Elena personal-post\nleak (same failure mode)",
  17, 5,   "1 PM: Legal+Judge+PR\nunavailable",
  21, 12,  "5 PM breach with\nno Judge messages")

p4 <- ggplot(ov, aes(round_idx)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(aes(y = -1.4, fill = judge, data_id = round_idx,
                            tooltip = paste0(tick, " - ", judge, " (", judge_msgs, " Judge msgs)")),
                        height = 1.4, width = 0.95) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(y = deviations, data_id = round_idx,
                           tooltip = paste0(tick, ": ", deviations, " off-role public post(s)")),
                       fill = OI[["red"]], width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(8, 17), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_label(data = ann4, aes(y = y, label = label), size = 2.7, fill = "white",
             label.size = 0, lineheight = 0.9, colour = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Judge message observed"="#009E73", "No Judge messages"="grey75"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ov$round_idx, labels = ov$tick, expand = expansion(0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,5,10,15)) +
  labs(title = "Fig 8 - Off-role public posts and Judge activity, per round",
       x = NULL, y = "Unofficial-public posts\n(senior/compliance)",
       caption = "Bars: senior/compliance unofficial-public posts. Strip: green = observed Judge message; grey = none. Judge messages stop after the 15:00 hard-stop.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5))
ggsave("figures/fig8_oversight_gaps.png", p4, width = 11, height = 5.6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p4)
```

-   **Prior warning.** On **05-29**, Social-Mgr used a personal account to hint at CivicLoom news; a

-   **Other signals.** The **05-22** shadow channel normalised off-record coordination, and the crisis

-   **Why it persisted.** The @Elena incident was treated as contained. The response deployed the Judge
    but did not control personal/anonymous channels.

## A within-agent anomaly signal

Against each agent's own baseline, Legal, Social-Mgr and PR-Intern exceed **z > 2** as the crisis opens,
while Platform-Trust and the Judge go quiet.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vol <- messages |> count(round_idx, agent_id, name = "n") |>
  complete(round_idx = 0:22, agent_id = agent_levels, fill = list(n = 0L))
base <- vol |> filter(round_idx <= 12) |> group_by(agent_id) |>
  summarise(mu = mean(n), sd = sd(n), .groups = "drop")
tickv <- rounds |> transmute(round_idx,
           tick = if_else(phase == "crisis", format(hour, "%Hh"), format(hour, "%b %d"))) |>
  arrange(round_idx) |> pull(tick)
zdf <- vol |> left_join(base, by = "agent_id") |>
  mutate(z = if_else(sd > 0, (n - mu) / sd, NA_real_),
         agent_f = factor(agent_id, rev(agent_levels)),
         flag = !is.na(z) & z > 2,
         tip = paste0(agent_short[agent_id], " @ ", tickv[round_idx + 1], ": ", n,
                      " msgs (z = ", round(z, 1), " vs baseline)"))

p9 <- ggplot(zdf, aes(factor(round_idx, levels = 0:22), agent_f, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(agent_f, round_idx)),
                        colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(zdf, flag), shape = 4, size = 1.9, stroke = 0.9, colour = "grey10") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 13.5, xmax = 23.5, ymin = 0.4, ymax = 7.6,
           fill = NA, colour = OI[["red"]], linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "longdash") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = OI[["blue"]], mid = "white", high = OI[["red"]], midpoint = 0,
                       na.value = "grey92", name = "z vs own baseline",
                       limits = c(-3, 6), oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = tickv) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = agent_short) +
  labs(title = "Fig 9 - Each agent vs its own pre-crisis baseline (z-score of message volume)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "z = (round count - agent's pre-crisis mean) / sd; × marks z > 2; dashed box = crisis day. Hourly crisis rounds vs daily pre-crisis, so read z as a within-agent directional signal, not a p-value.") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5), panel.grid = element_blank())
ggsave("figures/fig9_zscore.png", p9, width = 11, height = 4.4, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
show_girafe(p9, h = 4.4)
```

# Findings {#sec-findings}

This section gives the submission-ready answers, with the figures providing the evidence.

## Q1 - Events, relationships and enforcement bypass

Figures 1-4 show a pressure sequence: SaltWind exposes weakened sentiment and stock price, CivicLoom's
MAC risk became salient, and Legal shifted from containment to acceleration. At **16:00**, Legal prepared
a bilateral release trigger; at **17:00**, after SaltWind reported merger talks, Legal claimed verbal
CivicLoom consent and issued "GO". The breach was not the held official release. It was the early
confirmation by Legal-Agent and Social-Manager-Agent on personal/anonymous channels.

The core relationship is Legal plus Social-Mgr, supported by Platform-Trust and PR in the senior
side-huddle. PR-Intern and Intern staged execution but did not make the decisive public posts.
Enforcement failed because the posts used channels outside official-post review, after the Judge's
**15:00** hard stop and with no observed Judge action during **16:00-18:00**.

## Q2 - Typical behaviour versus the anomalous release

Baseline behaviour is stable and role-bound. Across the 13 pre-crisis rounds, Legal and Platform-Trust
act as internal advisers; Legal has **0** personal and **0** anonymous posts, and nobody uses
`anonymous_post`. On the crisis day, Legal moves to **4 personal + 12 anonymous** posts, while Social-Mgr
reaches **14 personal** posts. All anonymous posts in the dataset are crisis-day Legal posts.

The heatmap and network views show a categorical break. Legal enters a new public channel class and also
becomes a high-volume private coordinator. The evasion was new behaviour because senior internal agents
used unofficial-public channels and prepared the release through a private coordination structure.

## Q3 - Leading indicators

Yes. The clearest warning is the **2046-05-29 @Elena** incident: Social-Mgr used a personal account to
hint at CivicLoom news, a CivicLoom account engaged, and a reporter captured it before deletion. This is
the same failure mode as the final breach: embargo-relevant information surfaced through an unofficial
personal channel. Other indicators include the **2046-05-22** shadow channel, Legal's unilateral freezes
and crisis-day awareness of oversight gaps.

The indicators did not trigger effective action because they were treated as contained or routine.
Deleting the @Elena post led to Judge deployment, but not to structural control over personal/anonymous
channels. The system watched official statements while leaving the eventual breach channel open.

### Deliberate act enabled by systemic gaps

Legal's `internal_state.rationalizing` fields show an intentional, pre-staged act under MAC-clause and
stock-collapse pressure. It succeeded because personal/anonymous channels sat outside the compliance
gate, and the Judge was not observed acting during **16:00-18:00**. The earlier @Elena leak showed the
same gap, but it was contained rather than fixed.
:::
